environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the SQS consumer with default container configuration. The container runs as root with full Linux capabilities. The /var/spool/processor/output directory is a mounted EFS volume. An attacker who can send messages to the SQS queue (e.g., via compromised IAM credentials or misconfigured queue policy) can exploit the symlink following and arbitrary file write, then trigger command execution via the 'execute' action field.

config.sqs_queue_policy: allows SendMessage from multiple AWS accounts
